reporting_commitment: The preregistered target and minimum allocations are infeasible after promotion of 101 qualified clean programs and 69 qualified fault programs. The raw program options contain 45 two-clean tasks, 15 mirror-capable tasks, and 9 both-faulty-capable tasks; fixed development and challenge reservation leaves 41 two-clean control-eligible tasks. The algorithmically maximal evidence-constrained pilot contains 51 selected main items, of which the 8 mirror tasks are the only paired units in the locked primary estimand. Exact primary power is 0.015753443828124995 at paired MDE 0.2, two-sided alpha 0.05, and discordance 0.5. Power 0.8 is unattainable with 8 paired tasks under that discordance assumption; even the maximum risk difference 0.5 has power 0.14453125. The 51-item design-wide count is not used to inflate primary power. Any primary result will be reported with its true achieved power and will not be relabeled as meeting preregistration; the locked fewer-than-40-task analysis gate remains feasibility-only unless a separate downstream analysis deviation is recorded.
